annotations.title: Get Company Open Job Count & Hiring Breakdown

description: Get real-time open job count, department/country/remote/seniority breakdowns, salary disclosure count, and 24h/7d/30d hiring velocity for any company slug, domain, LinkedIn URL, or ATS URL.

linkedin_url.description: Optional LinkedIn company URL or ID (e.g. "https://www.linkedin.com/company/stripe/")

refresh.description: Set to true to trigger a live ETag check against Greenhouse/Lever/Ashby

slug.description: Company slug, domain, LinkedIn URL, or ATS URL (e.g. "stripe", "stripe.com", "https://boards.greenhouse.io/stripe")

name: get_company_job_count

data.description: Open job count, breakdowns by department/country/remote, and hiring velocity
